segments.approved_text: Crypto markets never stand still. As prices move, the coins inside your CryptoPack can drift away from their target allocation.

segments.approved_text: CryptoPack Rebalancing brings it back on track automatically—trimming coins that have become overweight and buying those that are underweight.
